# The frozen candidate against the calendar-aware GBM on quarter-end turns and year-ends (#1593)

**Development, not a verdict.** Generated by `scripts/qe_vs_calendar_gbm_1593.py page` from `docs/research/qe-vs-calendar-gbm-1593/result.json`, not edited by hand. Nothing here is adopted, registered or chosen, and (s3c-ann-net) stays frozen.

**Serves:** H5 step 3, on Eleonora's rulings of 12 and 13 November 2026 (#1593): the comparison only, from existing walks, no refit, paired and with intervals, by turn type (quarter-end turns and year-ends apart, the day types in force since #1161) and by regime, with **no combination arm** and nothing adopted. Reading it does not resume `gbm_funding` work.

**Settled questions** (`docs/research/settled-questions.md`, her rule of 9 November 2026). Q9 (the quarter-end family: #1531, #1548, #1572) holds the repairs of the candidate's band on these days; no entry compares the candidate with the calendar-aware GBM, so this is a new question beside Q9 and re-runs none of it. S9 (a spread model reads the calendar at the target day, on direct pairs) is kept: the variant reads the calendar columns at the target day on direct pairs, so it is not provisional under the calendar rule.

## What was compared

`sc_s3c_ann_net` (the candidate of `docs/research/h5-candidate.json`, regenerated as #1548 and #1572 regenerate it) against `gbm_funding_cal_direct` (#1036's walks, read from her Mac, not refitted), on the 1,855 decision days both cover (2018-07-19 to 2025-12-23; the candidate's development window has 1,855, the walks 1,855), 291 cells of h = 1 to 5 aimed at a quarter-end turn or a year-end. The candidate's figures on the whole group (pooled and by type, means and intervals) equal #1548's record to 1e-9, so the regenerated walk is the one scored there. Published panel `4ddc3882cd6d406b11e1088f8ff6195e16dde175a0ad6818abe40dd5bdac8999`, the walks' scratch panel `f9fae9dce43341f2816d19c76d9562f9773f0bff5891bd051f52eac0ffecb8f3`. No day after 2025-12-31 and no locked day is read.

**Orientation.** d is the GBM minus the candidate on the same cells. For grid CRPS, upper-tail twCRPS and the miss rates a negative d favours the GBM; for coverage a positive d does. The interval of d is the 90% event-cluster interval (whole events resampled, 2,000 resamples, seed 1593, the method of #1548 and #1572; the h = 1 to 5 forecasts aimed at one turn are one event, so the events column is the number of independent turns behind a cell).

**Decision instants.** The candidate's walk is read at the declared 18:00 decision instant (#1312); #1036's walks were made at the 16:00 instant of the published records. The GBM therefore forecast each day with two hours less of the day's public information than the candidate did. This favours the candidate, by an amount this study does not measure, and a refit of the GBM at 18:00 is outside the ruling. The decision day, the targets and the outcomes are the same in both (the script refuses a difference).

### The scoring protocol's interval on the per-target-day means

Per target day, the mean over the leads of each model's score; d is the GBM minus the candidate, in bp, with the studentized stationary bootstrap of scoring protocol v1 (mean block 10, HAC lag 10, 95%, 10,000 draws, seed 1593). A group is a set of target days that need not be consecutive, so the blocks run across its gaps: here the interval describes, it does not test. A group of no more than ten days carries its difference and no interval.

## Reading it

Cells resting on few events (under 5): group (turns and year-ends), 2020 (4); group (turns and year-ends), 2024 (4); group (turns and year-ends), 2025-26 (4); quarter-end turns, 2018-19 (4); quarter-end turns, 2020 (3); quarter-end turns, 2024 (3); quarter-end turns, 2025-26 (3); year-ends, 2018-19 (2); year-ends, 2020 (1); year-ends, 2021-23 (3); year-ends, 2024 (1); year-ends, 2025-26 (1).

Regime cells whose grid CRPS interval of d excludes zero: group (turns and year-ends), 2018-19 (+4.766 [+1.655, +8.403], 6 events); group (turns and year-ends), 2021-23 (+0.668 [+0.190, +1.182], 12 events); group (turns and year-ends), 2024 (+1.433 [+0.402, +2.398], 4 events); quarter-end turns, 2018-19 (+2.693 [+0.801, +4.702], 4 events); quarter-end turns, 2021-23 (+0.714 [+0.103, +1.358], 9 events); quarter-end turns, 2024 (+0.912 [+0.180, +1.643], 3 events); year-ends, 2018-19 (+8.912 [+3.045, +14.779], 2 events); year-ends, 2021-23 (+0.529 [+0.161, +0.896], 3 events). Whose upper-tail twCRPS interval excludes zero: group (turns and year-ends), 2018-19 (+4.575 [+1.369, +8.347], 6 events); group (turns and year-ends), 2021-23 (+0.029 [+0.006, +0.061], 12 events); quarter-end turns, 2018-19 (+2.447 [+0.291, +4.699], 4 events); quarter-end turns, 2021-23 (+0.032 [+0.001, +0.075], 9 events); year-ends, 2018-19 (+8.830 [+2.904, +14.757], 2 events); year-ends, 2021-23 (+0.020 [+0.002, +0.039], 3 events). Whose coverage interval excludes zero: group (turns and year-ends), 2021-23 (-0.258 [-0.483, -0.050], 12 events); quarter-end turns, 2021-23 (-0.311 [-0.578, -0.056], 9 events); year-ends, 2021-23 (-0.100 [-0.167, -0.033], 3 events). Whose interval of the miss rate above q95 excludes zero: year-ends, 2021-23 (+0.100 [+0.033, +0.167], 3 events). A cell of a single event resamples to itself, so its interval is a point and it is left out of these lists. With this many cells, several intervals are expected to exclude zero by chance, and none was chosen in advance.

## What this shows and does not show

It shows, on the cells both models forecast, how far the calendar-aware GBM's quantiles cover these turns and the year-ends against the candidate's, by turn type and regime, and how many independent events each figure rests on. It does not show that a combination of the two would do better (none was built), that the GBM would hold up on days after 2025-12-31 or in other regimes, or that either model's band is right: the quarter-end family (Q9) and the candidate's open failure stand as they did. The GBM's loss to `gbm_funding` outside 2021-23 (#1086, #1591) is a separate finding on other days. The cells are few and clustered in a handful of turns; the intervals are wide for that reason, and the regimes are not tested against one another. It is development data (scoring protocol v1): only prospective confirmation days give a verdict. Whether the result opens any further arm is Eleonora's decision.
